source.method: Nearest-neighbour source samples at output cell centres; null outside source bounds or where sampled source value is NoData. Not a full-resolution coverage inventory.
source.authors: Timothy Parker and Fred J. Calef III; JPL-Caltech / NASA / USGS / University of Arizona

local.source: USGS MSL Gale merged DEM v3 (2016), Parker & Calef
local.description: Nearest-sampled USGS merged DEM v3, tied to MOLA. 23.4 m display cells; source detail varies from HiRISE through CTX, HRSC and MOLA. Missing samples are masked.
local.resolution: 23.4 m display grid · variable source detail · not 1 m accuracy
